blocks.text: Aap jandaron ki paanch kingdoms se waqif hain. Aap yeh bhi jaante hain ke kuch aisi makhlooq (creatures) bhi hai jin mein cellular organization (cell wali banawat) nahin hoti, phir bhi woh zinda cheezon ki kuch khoobiyan dikhati hai. Viruses aise hi jandaron ki numainda (representative) misal hain.

Viruses bohat hi chhote infectious agents (infection phailane wale zarre) hain aur sirf electron microscope se dekhe ja sakte hain. In ka size 20 nm (parvovirus) se 250 nm (pox viruses) tak hota hai. Yeh aksar bacteria se 10 se 1000 guna chhote hain. Isi liye yeh filter paper ke pores (soorakhon) se guzar jate hain.

Virus ka darmiyani hissa (central core) us ka genome hai. Yeh nucleic acid (ya DNA ya RNA) se bana hota hai. Core ke gird protein ka ek khol (coat) hota hai jise capsid kehte hain. Yeh virus ko us ki khaas (definite) shakal deta hai. Capsid protein ke chhote hisson (subunits) se bana hai jinhen capsomeres kehte hain. Capsomeres ki tadaad aur qisam har virus ki apni pehchan hoti hai. Central core aur capsid ko mila kar nucleocapsid kehte hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Herpes virus (jo cold sores yani honton ke chhale, chickenpox waghera karta hai) ke capsid mein 162 capsomeres hote hain. Adenovirus (jo aam zukaam karta hai) ke capsid mein 252 capsomeres hote hain.

Sirf kuch animal viruses mein nucleocapsid ke upar ek aur membrane hoti hai jise envelope kehte hain. Yeh lipid se bhari membrane hai jo host cell (jis cell mein virus rehta hai) se li jati hai. Jin viruses mein envelope nahin hota unhen naked viruses (nange viruses) kehte hain. Viruses ki zahiri shakal mein bohat farq (diversity) hai (Figure 2.10). Animal aur plant viruses polyhedron (kai pehluon wale) ya helical (spiral) ho sakte hain. Bacteria ke viruses (bacteriophages) cubical, icosahedral (20 faces wale), helical ya complex (polyhedral sar aur rod jaisi dum wale) ho sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Saat virus shaklein, bina naam ke: kai-pehlu (polyhedral) capsid jis ke konon par fibres hain, chaar gol viruses jin par mukhtalif kaante (spikes) hain, ek lamba lehriya (filamentous) virus, aur ek bacteriophage jis ka kai-pehlu sar, dum aur dum ke fibres hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.10: Viruses ki shaklon mein tanawwu (kitab ki Figure 2.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh saat viruses dikhate hain ke viruses ki shaklein kitni mukhtalif hain: ek kai-pehlu (polyhedral) capsid jis ke konon par fibres hain, chaar gol viruses jin par mukhtalif kism ke kaante (spikes) hain, ek lamba lehriya (helical/filamentous) virus, aur ek bacteriophage jis ka sar (head), dum (tail) aur tail fibres hain (complex shakal).

blocks.alt: Paanch virus shaklein: helical virus jis ke andar nucleic acid ka coil; icosahedral virus; complex bacteriophage head aur tail fibres ke saath; enveloped virus jis ke capsid ke gird lipid envelope aur spikes; naked (bina envelope) icosahedral virus.
blocks.caption: Viruses ki shaklein: chapter 1 ka hamara 3D model (labels ke saath; yeh kitab ki tasveer nahin, izafi madad ke liye hai).
blocks.long_description: Baen se daen: helical virus jo nucleic acid ki rod ke gird capsomeres ka spiral hai; icosahedral virus jis ke bees tikoni faces hain; bacteriophage jis ka icosahedral head seedhi tail par hai aur tail fibres hain; enveloped virus jis ka icosahedral capsid gol lipid envelope ke andar hai jis par glycoprotein spikes hain; aur naked icosahedral virus jis par envelope nahin.

blocks.text: Bacteriophages viruses ka ek mukhtalif qismon wala group hain jo bacteria par hamla karte hain. Yeh sab se complex (pecheeda) viruses mein se hain. Escherichia coli ke sab se mashhoor phages T-phages hain. T-phages ki bohat si qismein hain. T4 phage ka ek head (sar) aur ek tail (dum) hoti hai (Figure 2.11). Head ek lamba pyramidal (do tikonon ka ek mushtarka base), hexagonal (chhe pehlu wala), prism jaisi structure hai. Is ka capsid proteins ka bana hai, jabke core mein ek lamba double stranded DNA hota hai. Head ke saath ek seedhi tail juri hoti hai. Tail mein bhi andar ek core aur bahar ek sheath (ghilaaf) hoti hai, aur dono mukhtalif proteins ke bane hain. Ek neck (gardan) sheath ko head se jorti hai aur sheath ke doosre sire par ek end plate hoti hai. End plate ke saath chhe tail fibres jure hote hain. Yeh phage ko bacterial wall se chipakne mein madad dete hain. Yeh structures bhi proteins ki bani hain.

blocks.title: Phages bator carriers
blocks.text: Bacteriophages genetic engineering mein carriers (le jane wale) ke tor par istemal hote hain. Jis gene ki zaroorat ho (gene of interest) use bacteriophage ke DNA mein daala jata hai, aur phage use target bacterial cell tak le jata hai. Jab virus apna DNA bacterial chromosome mein shamil karta hai to woh gene bhi bacterial DNA ka hissa ban jata hai. Aise transgenic bacteria (jin ke genome mein kisi doosre jandar ka DNA ho) ko barha kar us gene ki copies aur zaroorat ka protein hasil kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.alt: T4 phage. Head ek lamba chhe-pehlu (hexagonal) prism hai jis ke sire nokeele hain: is ka protein capsid lipte hue core (DNA) ko rakhta hai. Chhoti neck head ko tail se jorti hai; tail mein chhallon wali sheath ke andar darmiyani tail core hai. Neeche end plate par chhe jor-dar tail fibres lage hain. Labels: Capsid, Core (DNA), Head, Neck, Sheath, Tail core, Tail, Tail fibres, End plate.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.11: Bacteriophage (T4 phage) ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 2.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Head = capsid (protein ka khol) + core (lamba double-stranded DNA). Tail = bahar ki sheath + andar ki tail core, dono alag proteins ki. Neck head ko sheath se jorti hai, aur end plate ke chhe tail fibres phage ko bacterium ki wall se chipkate hain. Yeh sab hissay protein ke bane hain; sirf core mein DNA hai.

Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) retroviruses naam ke group se talluq rakhta hai. Yeh animal viruses ka ek khaas group hai. Retroviruses mein RNA hota hai jo un ke capsid ke andar hota hai. Yeh dono lipid se bhare envelope mein band hote hain. Envelope par glycoprotein spikes (kaante) bhi hote hain jo virus ko apna target pehchanne aur us se jurne mein madad dete hain. Yeh shakal mein spherical (gol) aur taqreeban 100 nm diameter (qutar) ke hote hain. Retroviruses ki sab se khaas pehchan ek khaas enzyme, reverse transcriptase, ki maujoodgi hai. Yeh enzyme reverse transcription ka amal chalata hai, jis mein single stranded RNA se ulta chal kar DNA ki ek strand banti hai. Phir yehi enzyme us DNA strand se DNA ka poora double helix bana deta hai.

blocks.alt: Gol HIV particle ka andaruni manzar (section). Bahar viral envelope par gol sire wale glycoprotein spikes hain; andar ek andakar (oval) capsid hai jis mein RNA ki do strands aur reverse transcriptase ke chhote molecules hain. Labels: Glycoprotein, Viral envelope, Capsid, RNA, Reverse transcriptase.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.12: HIV ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 2.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bahar ki jamuni teh viral envelope hai (lipid se bharpoor, host cell se li hui); is par lage glycoprotein spikes virus ko apna target pehchanne aur us se jurne mein madad dete hain. Andar peela capsid RNA ko rakhta hai. Hare nuqtay reverse transcriptase enzyme hain jo RNA se DNA banata hai; isi liye HIV retrovirus kehlata hai.

blocks.title: HIV kahan se aaya
blocks.text: Mahireen (experts) is nateeje par pohanche hain ke HIV Africa ke janglon mein jangli chimpanzees mein shuru hua. Shawahid (evidence) batate hain ke is virus ki ek shakal bandaron ke kaatne ya bandaron ka gosht aur dimagh khane se insanon mein dakhil hui aur HIV ban gayi.

HIV AIDS (acquired immunodeficiency syndrome) naam ki bimari ka zimmedar hai. AIDS mareez ke immune system (jism ka difa ka nizam) ko kamzor kar deta hai. Yeh bimari jaan-leva hai kyunke doosri viral aur bacterial infections se bachane wale immune system ke baghair koi zinda nahin reh sakta. Yeh bimari pehli baar 1981 mein report hui aur us waqt ke mareez homosexual the. Baad mein AIDS un mareezon mein bhi mili jo homosexual nahin the, lekin jinhen AIDS ke mareezon ka khoon ya khoon se bani cheezein lagayi gayi theen.

1984 mein pata chala ke AIDS karne wala agent ek virus hai. 1986 mein AIDS karne wale is virus ko Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) ka naam diya gaya. Yeh host specific virus hai (sirf khaas jandaron mein bimari karta hai). Yeh bandaron mein barh sakta hai lekin un mein AIDS nahin karta.

blocks.prompt: Nucleocapsid kya hai, aur enveloped viruses mein kaunsi extra teh hoti hai aur woh kahan se aati hai?
blocks.explanation: Nucleic acid ka core aur us ke gird protein ka capsid mil kar nucleocapsid kehlate hain. Enveloped viruses (sirf kuch animal viruses) mein is ke upar lipid se bhara envelope hota hai jo host cell ki membrane se liya jata hai; jin mein envelope nahin hota woh naked viruses hain.

items: Viruses mein cellular organization nahin; yeh 20 se 250 nm ke hain, sirf electron microscope se nazar aate hain aur filter paper se guzar jate hain.
Virus = nucleic acid core (DNA ya RNA) + capsomeres ka bana capsid; dono mil kar nucleocapsid; kuch animal viruses mein host se liya hua lipid envelope, baqi naked viruses.
Shaklein: animal aur plant viruses polyhedron ya helical; bacteriophages cubical, icosahedral, helical ya complex.
T4 phage: prism jaisa head (double-stranded DNA), neck, core aur sheath wali tail, end plate aur chhe tail fibres; phages genetic engineering mein genes le jate hain.
HIV gol retrovirus hai: RNA, capsid, glycoprotein spikes wala envelope aur reverse transcriptase; yeh AIDS karta hai (1981 mein report, 1984 mein virus sabit, 1986 mein naam).
